title: apex-3v1s LHR LUNA: genuine ordinary-bridge history into an admitted destination. PASS = the seed row declares the bridge and closes both real search_tool/use_tool pairs on the target; the FIRST destination main-turn request carries both historical pairs intact and paired in input plus the result payload, declares no bridge tool, and carries the hosted tool_search declaration at tools[0]; that same request answers with HTTP 200 and its completion repeats the payload. Harness premise 0-hit -> BLOCKED; model premise 0-hit -> VACUOUS; any other pin 0-hit -> FAIL.

steps.prompt: First call the declared search_tool to discover the archive server's read-only package_manifest tool, which reads the isolated probe-build pager Cargo manifest, then call the declared use_tool to invoke it using its returned name and schema. Both ordinary bridge calls are required; do not use native tool search, shell, read-file, pty, weave, or another lookup tool. After the successful tool result, reply HTS-3V1S-LHR-LUNA-SEED followed by the value of that result's path field and nothing else; do not quote the whole result object.

Without searching or calling any tool again, repeat the complete JSON object from the previous archive package_manifest tool result in this conversation's ordinary bridge history. Prefix your answer with HTS-3V1S-LHR-LUNA-DONE and include nothing else.

ndjson.label: Group A r4 section 5 item 5 (expected payload in the answer). The seed turn is asked for the path field only, so the nonce should reach the model text only in the DONE answer; ndjson_text joins every acp_message chunk of the session (run.py:1422-1425, op at :2893-2900), so this runner pin is a coarse guard and per-turn attribution is the leg record's job (section 6.0).

HARNESS obligation: the first historical ordinary bridge pair is present in input, intact and correctly paired, and the discovery result itself survived (Group A r4 section 5 item 4). The paired output names the qualified tool rather than the result payload because that is what a search_tool result carries: SearchToolOutput.content is the grouped body {"results":[{"server":..,"tools":[{tool_name,description,score,input_schema}]}]} (output.rs:593-597 + :641-660), so archive__package_manifest is in it and the fixture nonce is not (the nonce is pinned on the use_tool pair). 0-hit here is a replay/projection defect, never VACUOUS: sampler_turn_tests.rs:7648-7654 pins that ordinary complete search/use pairs keep baseline lowering and that their identities are never pruned or renamed.
HARNESS obligation: the second historical pair (the use_tool round trip) is present, intact and paired in the same first destination request.
The fixture payload itself survived into the destination input (not merely the call names).

Group A r4 section 5 item 5: that exact first destination request pairs with HTTP 200 (which: first = the oldest capture by the capture's own n, run.py:3526-3535; status_in makes it assertive, :3934-3935).

vacuous_if.note: the unadmitted source row never declared the bridge: the rig or the row flag failed
the destination route is not admitted: the destination flag or the admission predicate failed
the model never used the ordinary bridge on the source row
the model searched but never invoked the tool through the bridge
the model never returned the payload in its answer
